entries.camera: Canted (dutch-angle) low-angle action shot from ground level behind the figure, wide lens, frozen at a high shutter speed.
entries.subject: A huge broad-shouldered barbarian in a fur-trimmed leather vest, seen from behind, spinning in a frenzy with a heavy axe in each hand and smashing both into a thick oak palisade gate. The gate explodes outward into a storm of splinters, torn iron bands and sparks, frozen in mid-air around the blurred ring of the swinging arms. Heat shimmers off the shoulders and the snow has melted in a circle around the boots. A dark pine forest stands behind the fence.
entries.accent: furnace orange-red heat haze over cold slate-blue

entries.camera: Side-on telephoto freeze-frame close-up, 135mm look, very shallow depth of field, the spiked shoulder in sharp focus.
entries.subject: A hulking figure in massive plate armour bristling with long steel spikes, cropped at the chest so only a spiked pauldron, a spiked gauntlet and the edge of a closed spiked helm are visible, charging shoulder-first through a stone wall. The wall bursts into flying blocks and dust frozen in mid-air, and the spikes glow where they bite the stone, throwing white-hot sparks. Behind, the blurred interior of a ruined hall with toppled barrels and a collapsed beam.
entries.accent: iron-black armour with brass-yellow glints and white-hot sparks

entries.camera: Extreme worm's-eye low angle from the forest floor, looking straight up between huge pine trunks, ultra-wide lens.
entries.subject: A colossal silhouetted barbarian seen from behind and far below, ten times taller than the pines, its head lost in low clouds. In one hand it holds a greataxe the size of a ship's mast, the blade sheathed in glittering frost and crackling cold light that spills down through the branches as a swirling mist. The trees reach only to the giant's knees, and snow slides from the branches shaken loose by its step.
entries.accent: glacial ice-cyan frost on dark grey granite

entries.camera: Backlit silhouette against a lightning flash, 35mm, medium-wide from slightly behind, the figure in the lower third of the frame.
entries.subject: A lone barbarian silhouette on a wind-scoured ridge, seen from behind, fists clenched, standing inside a slowly turning sphere of storm: a ring of rain, torn cloud and branching lightning orbiting at arm's length. A bolt strikes the ground nearby and throws the figure into sharp rim light while the grass and a tattered cloak whip flat in the wind. Beyond the ridge a wall of black thunderheads towers over a dark valley.
entries.accent: electric violet-white lightning in deep indigo storm clouds

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, wide lens, the figure at the exact centre of a round floor.
entries.subject: Looking straight down at a hooded barbarian in a fur cloak crouched at the centre of a round cracked stone floor, one fist slammed into the ground. A burst of chaotic magic spreads outward in uneven patches, each a different effect: flowers sprouting from the cracks, floating pebbles, a disc of frost, a swirl of fireflies, a tiny whirlwind, a bright column of light. Nothing is symmetrical except the crouching centre, and the patches overlap like spilled paint.
entries.accent: chaotic magenta-pink with lime-green and gold flecks

entries.camera: Extreme macro close-up at hand height, 100mm look, very shallow depth of field, the lens slightly below the hand.
entries.subject: A forearm wrapped in leather straps, cropped at the elbow, the fist opened so that long curved claws of pale spectral light extend from the knuckles and drag four deep furrows through a slab of dark stone, grit and sparks peeling away. A faint ghostly outline of a great beast's paw surrounds the hand, its fur and sinew made of glowing mist. Behind, a blurred misty forest at dusk and the curl of a lashing tail made of light.
entries.accent: feral moss green with bone-white spectral claw light

entries.camera: Eye-level over-the-shoulder view, medium-wide, the foreground figure slightly out of focus and the spirits in sharp focus.
entries.subject: A barbarian seen from behind in the soft-focus foreground, one hand resting on a huge round shield planted in the earth. Beyond it, in a mist-ringed circle of standing stones at night, a line of tall translucent spirit warriors made of silver light stands shoulder to shoulder, each raising a great round shield, their faces only blank swirls of light, forming a glowing wall. Drifting leaves and motes of light fill the air between them.
entries.accent: ghostly silver-white spirit light over deep umber earth

entries.camera: Symmetrical frontal eye-level medium shot, 50mm, the totem pole dead centre of the frame.
entries.subject: A tall carved wooden totem pole stands in a misty forest clearing, its stacked carvings of a bear, an eagle and a wolf glowing faintly. From the carvings three translucent spirit animals uncoil around the pole in ribbons of light: the bear low and heavy, the wolf circling, the eagle spreading above. A barbarian kneels at the foot of the pole, seen from behind, one hand flat against the wood, with feathers and bone charms swaying from the pole in the wind.
entries.accent: warm ochre and terracotta wood with a pale turquoise spirit glow

entries.camera: Telephoto compressed view across a dawn meadow at knee height, 200mm look, the figure small and the spirit large.
entries.subject: At dawn in a wide meadow, a small barbarian silhouette stands seen from behind with arms open. Rising behind the figure, a huge translucent bear made entirely of wind-blown grass, petals and leaves stands upright over the meadow, its outline dissolving into drifting pollen. A spirit eagle of leaves circles overhead and a wolf of mist waits at the figure's side, while deer and birds stand calm in the long grass.
entries.accent: soft dawn peach-pink over dewy meadow gold

entries.camera: Extreme wide symmetrical establishing shot from a far shore, eye level, the tree filling the whole sky.
entries.subject: A colossal world tree with a trunk as wide as a mountain rises from the edge of a still lake of light, its branches spreading across the whole sky. Each branch ends in a glowing circular doorway showing a different distant land: a desert, a snowfield, a jungle, a sea. The roots plunge into the water and glow with golden sap. A tiny barbarian silhouette stands on one great root at the foot of the trunk, seen from behind.
entries.accent: deep sapphire-blue night with golden sap light and silver starlight

entries.camera: Side-on horizontal close-up still life at floor level, very shallow depth of field, the axe head sharp in the centre.
entries.subject: A massive greataxe planted blade-down in the cracked floor of a ruined stone hall, its head wrapped in searing white-gold fire while a single shaft of blinding light pours through a hole in the broken roof onto it. A gauntleted hand cropped at the wrist grips the haft, with strips of crimson cloth tied to it drifting upward in the heat. Scorched flagstones radiate in a ring and ash flutters like snow.
entries.accent: searing white-gold divine light with deep crimson cloth
